source_evidence.rule: Character level is at least SkillTable.Level (word 8) for the active class-skill position.
Skill is available, SkillTable word 18 is not -1, and its saved rank is above zero.
Saved per-position rank is no greater than character level minus SkillTable.Level (word 8).
The native caller additionally requires a skill point and current rank below the unlocked-difficulty CharacterDesign MaxSkillLevel constant; mutation consumes one point and increments the saved rank.

design_caps.runtime_input: Caller supplies the actual unlocked difficulty and all three source-loaded caps; missing caps leave training unknown and fail closed.

implementation.state_owner: The caller's existing CharacterState is read and mutated in place; no native VM, profile, or copied progression owner is created.
implementation.source_rows: Class SkillTree, active saved SkillList order, SkillTable requirement/type, and saved rank are resolved from actual source tables and the same CharacterState.
implementation.mutation: After every gate passes, decrement source_skill_points and increment only the matched saved skill rank. Rejections leave points, ranks, and slot mappings unchanged.

authored_action_order.first_spend: When AddedStatsThisTurn is false and useSkillPoint is false, call NativeSaveGame before NativeSkillsTrainSkill(skillId, player=0), then set useSkillPoint true.
authored_action_order.later_spends: Skip NativeSaveGame and call NativeSkillsTrainSkill(skillId, player=0) directly.
authored_action_order.probe: The skill-button onUp call supplies the third argument true; this is the nonmutating IncSkill probe. The btn_add training call supplies two arguments, so the source flag defaults false and mutates.

verification.fixture: Actual Android-cache CharacterTable and SkillTables; KnightPlayerBase active SkillList; actual SkillTable row 51.
checks: one-point/one-rank training with unchanged saved slots
zero-point and CharacterDesign-cap rejection with state snapshots unchanged
missing-cap unknown state and fail-closed mutation
